# Privacy Policy — iSmart Technologies

**Effective Date:** October 9, 2026

**iSmart Technologies** ("we", "us", or "our") operates mobile applications under the **100 Days 100 Apps** series, including **GST Calculator India** and related utility applications.

## 1. Information We Collect
Our applications are built with privacy first. We do **not** require account creation, registration, or submission of personal identifiable information (PII) such as your name, email address, or phone number to use the core functionality.

## 2. Calculation Data & Local Storage
All financial inputs, GST calculations, and math expressions entered into the application are processed locally on your mobile device. We do not transmit, collect, or store your calculation entries on external servers.

## 3. Third-Party Services & Advertising
Our applications utilize Google AdMob to display advertisements. Google AdMob may collect and use pseudonymous device identifiers (such as Advertising ID) and usage data to serve relevant ads in compliance with Google's Advertising Policies.

For more information, please review [Google's Advertising Privacy Policies](https://policies.google.com/technologies/ads).

## 4. Device Permissions
The application only requests standard network access permissions necessary to load advertisement banners and enable native sharing features. No sensitive permissions (such as camera, contacts, or location) are requested.

## 5. Children's Privacy
Our applications do not knowingly collect any personal data from children under the age of 13.

## 6. Contact Us
If you have any questions or suggestions regarding this Privacy Policy, contact us at:
